definitions.explanation: A person who is not married. Gender-neutral — applies to both men and women.

examples.japanese: {独身者|どくしんしゃ}{向|む}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦マンション→マンション：01035_manshon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: Apartments aimed at single people are increasing.

examples.japanese: {独身者|どくしんしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{割合|わりあい}→割合：01760_wariai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{年々|ねんねん}→年々：10417_nennen⟧⟦{増加|ぞうか}→増加：03329_zouka⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The proportion of unmarried people is increasing year by year.

examples.japanese: {独身者|どくしんしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{食生活|しょくせいかつ}→食生活：21071_shokuseikatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{栄養|えいよう}→栄養：01882_eiyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{偏|かたよ}り→偏る：07872_katayoru⟧がちだ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: It is said that single people tend to have unbalanced diets.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{独身|どくしん}→独身：03486_dokushin⟧ (single, unmarried) and ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person). More formal than ⟦{独身|どくしん}→独身：03486_dokushin⟧ alone.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{独身|どくしん}→独身：03486_dokushin⟧ is the more common everyday word for 'single'
- ⟦{未婚|みこん}→未婚：14933_mikon⟧ emphasizes 'never married' (vs. divorced or widowed)
- ⟦{独|ひと}り{身|み}→独り身：17525_hitorimi⟧ means 'living alone' and may include divorced or widowed people

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {独身者|どくしんしゃ}{向|む}け (aimed at singles)
- {独身者|どくしんしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{増加|ぞうか}→増加：03329_zouka⟧ (increase in singles)
- {独身者|どくしんしゃ}⟦{世帯|せたい}→世帯：06870_setai⟧ (single-person household)
